label: MEAF6::PHF1

sections.text: MEAF6 encodes a component of histone acetyltransferase complexes.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 64769 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: PHF1 encodes a Polycomb-associated protein involved in transcriptional repression.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 5252 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: MEAF6::PHF1 joins MEAF6 exon 5 to PHF1 exon 2 in a reported endometrial stromal sarcoma. The same fusion has also been molecularly validated in ossifying fibromyxoid tumors.

audit_evidence.scope: Sequenced MEAF6 exon 5-PHF1 exon 2 transcript in an ESS; altered HAT targeting is a hypothesis, not demonstrated fusion mechanism.

audit_evidence.location: Results: FusionSeq identifies ZC3H7B-BCOR; MEAF6-PHF1; EPC1 rearrangements; Figures 2–4; Table 1
audit_evidence.scope: Molecularly validated fusions in ossifying fibromyxoid tumors; establishes associations beyond ESS.
